column1: # drain-scan rule registry (machine-readable). OWNER: track D - single source of enrichment.
# Tracks do NOT edit this file; they only write detectors. The scanner (scan) joins each raw
# engine hit to this registry by the detector's `argument` id (core detectors) / the Semgrep
# rule id. Engine is our own `core` analysis over the solc AST - Slither is NOT used anywhere.
# RULES.md = for humans; rules.tsv = for the scanner; validate/anchors.tsv = for validation.
#   rule_id  vector  engine  severity  detector_module  poc_fixture  fix_doc  summary
#     detector_module : repo-rel path to the core Detector module (detectors/rN_*.py), or '-'
#                       if not yet implemented (scanner skips '-'; the row still enriches a hit).
#     poc_fixture     : representative vulnerable PoC in the wallet-harness corpus.
#     fix_doc         : where to read how to fix it.

column8: unbounded approve(max) to an arbitrary spender
allowance left non-zero after the action (no reset)
permit/Permit2 consumed beyond the action amount
auth signature verified without deadline/nonce/domain binding
ecrecover over a raw digest not built via EIP-712 (ERC-1271)
delegatecall to a mutable / attacker-settable target (own-code AST; governed-proxy suppressed)
account forwards delegate execution to a calldata-supplied target with no allow-list
persistent trust/approval to an external address with no codehash pin
implementation/module/delegate swappable by a single key, no timelock/guardian
arbitrary caller-supplied call / unbound transferFrom spends a standing approval (F1 call / F2 unbound transferFrom)
externally-callable unguarded initializer installs an authority role (init-hijack): no re-init guard, modifier, or access control -> anyone seizes the role

approve/forceApprove/increaseAllowance to a caller-supplied, unvalidated spender over a token balance the contract itself custodies (pooled custody) -> residual allowance drains the pool; distinct from R1 (unbounded amount) and R3 (single-fn no-reset)

reentrant callback re-targets a standing setApprovalForAll/approval: a post-external-call re-read of externally-mutable storage (CEI violation) lets an unguarded entrypoint swap the victim mid-callback

ERC-1271 forged / permissive signer trust: a wallet authorizes an asset sink on an isValidSignature attestation from a signer contract it does not control (caller-supplied signer / permissive non-magic result / ERC-6492 deploy-and-trust); distinct from R5/R6 (EOA ecrecover) -- axis is contract-signer trust, gated by an asset sink
